capabilities: Insert callouts from saved templates via command, hotkey or mobile toolbar
Wrap selected text in a callout
Copy a callout's content as Markdown without > and [!type] markers
Copy callouts nested inside other callouts
Manage templates, types, titles and fold states in settings
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Supports English and Chinese interfaces and works on mobile.
intentEvidence: adds a copy button to the callout's title bar
problem: Inserting callouts means typing the > [!type] marker by hand, and selecting callout text for copying drags in quote markers or loses formatting.
summary: Callout helper that inserts callouts from saved templates and adds a copy button that copies a callout's content as clean Markdown.
